clips.title: The story
paras: At the Decrepit Ferry, rot hides swarm the dock east of The Sepulcher. High Executor Hadrec sends Forsaken champions to learn why the Scourge has gathered along Lordamere Lake's shore.

High Executor Hadrec turns east after the Scourge presence in the Dead Fields is suppressed. The Decrepit Ferry lies among Silverpine Forest's eastern waterways, where mainland Lordaeron once connected to the island estates of Lordamere Lake. Now undead gather around its rotted piers. Hadrec sends scouts to find out what draws the Lich King's servants there.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, we've discovered a new hive for the Scourge: the Decrepit Ferry. The ferry lies east of the Sepulcher, and is heavily patrolled by rot hides and other traveler.
There must be a reason for the Scourge's occupation of the area. Go to the Decrepit Ferry and find out why the Scourge are there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Heaped within this boat is a pile of wrapped corpses. And looking east across Lordamere Lake, an opposing dock on Fenris Isle can be seen.
The fate of the corpses must lie on Fenris Isle.
